note: The meeting builder film: Sunday to Sunday, every role. 25 scenes.

scenes.headline: The meeting is built before anybody walks in
scenes.line: The branch meets on a Wednesday morning. Ninety minutes. The meeting is built before anybody walks in.

scenes.headline: Out of the week you already worked
scenes.line: It is built out of the week you already worked.

scenes.headline: The week closes itself
scenes.line: The week runs Sunday to Sunday. On Sunday evening it closes. The figures freeze, and nothing moves under a number that has already been read out.

scenes.headline: Then the Branch Portfolio is read
scenes.line: Then the Branch Portfolio is read. Applications in. Policies issued. What is still sitting, and what is owed.
scenes.note: Nobody types any of this. It is read off the sheet the branch already keeps.

scenes.headline: Sales support adds the rest
scenes.line: Sales support adds the rest. Every renewal, every claim and every questionnaire is a line in the record.
scenes.note: Every renewal, every claim, every questionnaire — a line in the record.

scenes.headline: Your own data, nobody else’s
scenes.line: Every working morning you get your own data. What is still on your list. Where you stand against your target. Nobody else's figures, and nobody else sees yours.

scenes.headline: The first check goes out
scenes.line: At ten, the first check goes out.

scenes.headline: Tap what you did
scenes.line: Fifteen seconds. Tap what you did. Prospecting. Calls. A client seen. A fact find. Nothing to type unless you want to.
cues: Nothing to type unless you want to

scenes.headline: The afternoon, while you remember it
scenes.line: At three, the afternoon. While you still remember it.

scenes.headline: The week writes itself
scenes.line: Nobody writes a report. The week writes itself.
scenes.note: Two checks a day, fifteen seconds each. The week writes itself.

scenes.headline: It reads all of it
scenes.line: At seven on Wednesday the builder reads all of it. It knows who worked, and on what.

scenes.headline: Which numbers moved
scenes.line: It knows which numbers moved, and which did not.
scenes.title: What moved this week

scenes.headline: Who has not presented lately
scenes.line: It knows who has not presented lately. So it asks them.
scenes.note: So it asks them. The rota picks, not the chair.

scenes.headline: It writes the agenda
scenes.line: And it writes the agenda. Eleven items. Ninety minutes. A name against every one.

scenes.headline: The login is the register
scenes.line: Nine o'clock. Everybody logs in. The login is the register.
scenes.title: Nine o’clock
scenes.note: Nobody is marked in from the front. If you do not sign in, you are absent.

scenes.headline: Your own item is already at the top
scenes.line: You open the meeting. Your own item is already at the top.
scenes.title: Your agenda
scenes.note: Yours is at the top because it is yours, not because it is first.

scenes.headline: Last week’s open items, by name
scenes.line: Three minutes past, the branch manager takes last week's open items, by name and by date. Nothing new is raised until those are spoken to.
scenes.says: “Nothing new is raised until these are spoken to.”
cues: Nothing new until those are answered

scenes.headline: Applications in, issued, and still sitting
scenes.line: Ten past, sales support. Applications in, applications issued, and what is still sitting, with the oldest one named.
scenes.says: “The oldest one gets named every week until it moves.”

scenes.headline: The unit round: everybody with something moving
scenes.line: Twenty past, the B M E takes the unit round. Everybody with something moving says what moved.

scenes.headline: One case, in their own words
scenes.line: Ten to ten, one case in somebody's own words. Chosen by the rota, not by the chair.
rows: A lapsed policy, back in force
Asked what changed, not why they stopped
Who else on my list is in the same place?
scenes.says: “Chosen by the rota, not by the chair.”

scenes.headline: Their own link, this meeting only
scenes.line: A guest opens their own link and joins the same agenda. They see this meeting, and nothing else of the branch.
cues: And nothing else of the branch

scenes.headline: Every person names one client
scenes.line: And every single week, every person in the room names one client. About twenty seconds each. Nobody leaves without naming one.
scenes.note: Nobody leaves without naming one. That is the list Monday is built from.

scenes.headline: The actions are chased
scenes.line: On Thursday the actions are chased. And the week starts again.
scenes.note: Chased on Thursday, carried to Monday, read out next Wednesday.

scenes.headline: The week builds the meeting
scenes.line: The week builds the meeting.
scenes.nlabel: and not one of them yours alone
scenes.note: Sunday to Sunday. Everybody presents. Nobody writes a report.

scenes.headline: The week builds the meeting
scenes.line: Wednesday, nine to half past ten. Ricky Rampersad Branch dot com, slash meetings.
